title: Titan X Lemon Lime Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Lemon Lime is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This convenient refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, delivering a long-lasting, hassle-free vaping experience. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to vape. The Lemon Lime flavour captures the zesty freshness of Lemon and the crisp bite of Lime, creating a bright, citrusy vape with a sharp yet balanced finish. Bold and refreshing without being overpowering, this lively blend is balanced by a smooth nicotine salt formulation for a comfortable mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape and rapid nicotine relief. Paired with a pre-installed mesh coil for enhanced flavour and vapour production, the Titan X Refill Kit complements the Titan X’s intelligent auto-refill technology, providing up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent).
